name: Close
summary: Sales CRM with built-in calling, email and AI.
description: Close builds calling, SMS, email and sequences into the CRM with no extra tools. Its AI features transcribe and summarize calls and draft follow-up emails.

description_fr: Close intègre appels, SMS, emails et séquences dans le CRM, sans outil supplémentaire. Ses fonctions IA transcrivent et résument les appels et rédigent des emails de suivi.
